svg.title: Experience: mission log
svg.desc: Samsung R&D Institute India, Research Intern · PRISM, Jan – Jul 2026: Applied deep-learning research on computational imaging for mobile deployment.; Custom attention network, iterated over 15+ architecture variants.; Synthetic-to-real data pipeline that narrowed the sim-to-real gap.. KRSP, Software Development Intern, Feb – Jun 2026: Cross-platform rental marketplace in Flutter and Firebase.; Role-based tenant and landlord flows with offline sync.; React web client with maps and Stripe; ~40% faster loads.. DRDO – DMSRDE, Research Intern, Aug – Sep 2024: Camouflage Pattern Synthesis System using CNNs, CTNs and K-means.; Adaptive designs across 4+ terrain types.; Cut manual pattern iteration time by ~60%.
